failedTitle: We couldn't find this part of the interface.
failedBody: It may not be available in your current workspace. You can retry, skip this step, or exit the tour.
tourHomeReporter: This is your starting point. From here you can report wildlife and follow what happened to your reports.
tourHomePro: This is your dashboard home: resume open incidents and see what needs attention.
tourReportTextR: Start here whenever you find wildlife you want to record. A guided wizard walks you through it — Unknown is always a valid answer.
tourReportTextP: Start a new incident. The guided wizard records what was observed, step by step.
tourReportsTextR: This is where your reports live — in progress, awaiting response, and resolved.
tourReportsTextP: This is where all incidents live — active, closed and archived. Let's open it.
tourSearchTextR: Search your reports by reference, animal or location.
tourSearchTextP: Search by incident reference, species, location, organization or notes — anything you wrote.
tourFiltersText: Use filters to narrow the list — by status and incident type.
tourTimelineText: This keeps the history of what happened — every observation, photo and correction in order.
tourExportTextR: Generate a summary of your report to share — a privacy-safe version leaves out your contact details and exact location unless you choose otherwise.
tourExportTextP: Generate a print-ready handoff summary, or a privacy-safe shareable version.
tourGuideTextR: If you're ever unsure what to do, Guide me walks you through a real report one friendly step at a time.
tourGuideTextP: Guide me walks through key workflows step by step — reporting, handoffs, exports.
tourSettingsText: Themes, motion, accessibility, privacy and backups live here. Your data stays on this device.
demoTitle1: This is a fictional demo incident
demoText1: Demo cases open in the same workspace as real incidents, but stay clearly labeled as fictional.
demoText2: You can explore its timeline, status and handoff information exactly like a real case.
demoText3: Nothing here enters your real reports unless you choose “Copy into my workspace” back on the examples page.
guidedBlurb: A short interactive walkthrough using a fictional case: you've received a report of a bird beside a road, unable to fly.
tourHeaderText: This is the incident header: the status chip, current custody and the next step always live here, so anyone can see where the case stands at a glance.
tourPeopleText: Record who takes responsibility: transfers, custody history and receiving organizations live here.
tourStatusText: The status chip shows where the report stands — from Reported through In care to Released. Help → Statuses explains every one.
